prompt:
Create a high fidelity desktop web application UI comp, edge to edge, crisp readable text, no browser frame or device. Product: Bakiano / Madrid Delivery Sim, a local operations lab where technical reviewers follow queue-driven agents through delivery, tools, models and recovery. Pinned direction is Linear-style dark ops console, calm and dense, graphite surfaces with one muted teal accent for selected evidence/routes, amber/red only for warning/error states. IBM Plex Sans UI paired with IBM Plex Mono technical numbers. No purple, gradients, decorative hero, oversized titles, nested cards or dashboard decoration.

This option is EVIDENCE-LED. Slim shared top navigation: Delivery, Restaurants, Inventory, Health, Traces, Architecture, Madrid baseline. Compact title 'Delivery operations' and 'Synthetic session • Local rules', 'Start simulation' action. A wide central working area is an inspectable vertical execution timeline: 'Order received', 'Inventory reserved', 'Dispatch assigned', 'Route accepted', 'Parcel delivered', with role, event ID and timestamps. Show a selected 'Route accepted' step expanded into a clear brief, outcome and source-event link; payload is collapsed. A narrow left work area lists agents with role/status filters, readable status pills and small throughput histories. A tall right work area holds a muted dark synthetic city-grid map with one teal route, custom courier/store/home markers, a legend and selected courier label. Across the bottom a restrained four-cell KPI strip reads 'Orders/min 0.6', 'On-time 91%', 'Cost / delivery — Not recorded', 'p95 decision — No model calls'. The signature is selecting an execution step and seeing its agent and route highlighted together. Compose for a 1440×960 laptop screen; use familiar controls, excellent alignment and functional density. Make this visually distinct from a map-dominant dashboard.
